title: Top 5 People Who UNLOCKED The Universe
hook: Number one basically invented modern space itself.

items.name: Galileo Galilei
items.stat: In 1610 his homemade telescope revealed Jupiter's four largest moons, proving not everything orbits Earth.

items.name: Edwin Hubble
items.stat: In 1929 he proved the universe is expanding, with distant galaxies fleeing faster the farther they are.

items.name: Johannes Kepler
items.stat: His three laws showed planets orbit in ellipses, not perfect circles, decoding the entire solar system.

items.name: Isaac Newton
items.stat: His law of universal gravitation explained why planets orbit and apples fall with a single equation.

items.name: Albert Einstein
items.stat: His 1915 general relativity predicted black holes and gravitational waves, confirmed a century later.
